The rat shopkeeper turns away and immediately shoves her needle pouch under the shelf, and several rats holding wooden sticks pop out from behind the tubs. Feifei: "Those are my needles! Y-you can't just take things!"
地窖冒著熱氣，門口掛著一塊寫著「澡堂」的木牌。老鼠掌櫃站在櫃台後面搓著手：「泡一: Steam rises from the cellar, and a wooden sign reading "Bathhouse" hangs at the entrance. The rat shopkeeper stands behind the counter, rubbing paws together: "Twenty a soak! Leave your luggage at the counter -- guaranteed, nothing will go missing!" Inside, several wooden tubs give off white steam; on the shelves behind the counter, luggage of every kind is piled up. Feifei looks at the tubs, then at the wounds on her hands. Feifei: "If I soak for a bit... the wounds should feel a little better, right?"
菲菲用兩根手指一點一點抽出布包。就差一點點時，熊翻了個身，整個壓在她身上。她被壓: With two fingers, Feifei inches the cloth bundle out little by little. Just as she is almost there, the bear rolls over and flops down on top of her. Pinned beneath the bear's belly, it takes her ages to squeeze out from under its armpit, the cloth bundle still clutched to her chest, tears nearly falling. Feifei: "Ugh... I-I got it."
菲菲把滑到地上的被子輕輕拉起，替熊蓋好。熊在夢裡咂咂嘴，伸手一撈，把她整隻抱進懷: Feifei gently pulls up the quilt that has slid to the floor and tucks it over the bear. The bear smacks its lips in its dream, reaches out, and scoops her up whole into its arms. She freezes, not daring to move; the bear's belly is toasty warm, and before she knows it she has fallen asleep too. When she wakes, the bear presses a small jar into her hands and rolls over to keep sleeping. Feifei: "...So warm. Like when Master carried me home on his back when I was little."
菲菲拿針輕輕戳了戳熊的鼻子。熊睜開一隻眼，看見她，又看見懷裡的布包，慢慢坐了起來: Feifei gently pokes the bear's nose with a needle. The bear opens one eye, sees her, then sees the cloth bundle in its arms, and slowly sits up -- sitting up, it is as tall as three of her. Feifei: "S-sorry for waking you up... but that cloth bundle..."
地窖最裡面，一隻大熊蜷在稻草堆上睡覺，鼾聲震得架上的罐子叮噹響。牠懷裡抱著一個布: At the very back of the cellar, a big bear lies curled on a pile of straw, its snores rattling the jars on the shelves. It hugs a cloth bundle, with something shiny peeking out of the opening; the quilt has slid halfway off, and a few unopened jars of honey are scattered by its feet. Feifei holds her breath and even softens her footsteps. Feifei: "It... is really asleep, right?"
菲菲鼓起勇氣爬上梯子，梯子卻「喀啦」一聲沿著滑軌滑了出去。她抱緊梯子尖叫著一路滑: Feifei summons her courage and climbs the ladder, but with a "clatter" it slides off along its rail. Clutching the ladder and screaming, she slides all the way along, and as she passes the shelf section with the paw mark, she still manages to reach out and pull out three books. The ladder crashes into the end, and she tumbles down with it. Feifei: "Ugh... but the books didn't fall."
菲菲付了押金，抱著書坐在地上，一邊看一邊在本子上抄重點。抄到第二招時，她趴在本子: Feifei pays the deposit, sits on the floor hugging the books, and copies key points into her notebook as she reads. When she gets to the second move, she falls asleep on top of the notebook -- and when she wakes, drool has smudged a small patch of the book's page. Feifei: "S-sorry! The deposit... you can keep it." Still, she copied those two moves down word for word.
菲菲縮在兩排書架中間，抱著竹筒睡著了。書庫又暗又安靜，只有管理員的鼾聲。醒來時，: Feifei curls up between two rows of bookshelves and falls asleep hugging her bamboo tube. The library is dark and quiet, with only the librarian's snoring. When she wakes, there is a thin blanket over her and a cup of warm water beside her. Feifei: "...Who was it? Thank you."
書庫的書架高得看不到頂，一架滑軌梯子斜靠在最高那層。櫃台後的老貓管理員戴著圓眼鏡: The library's bookshelves are so tall that their tops are out of sight, and a rail ladder leans at an angle against the highest shelf. Behind the counter, the old cat librarian in round glasses is dozing, with a sign standing in front: "Book deposit: forty, no refund if soiled." Feifei cranes her neck until it aches. On the spines of the books on the highest shelf is painted a big cat paw print, just like Master's mark. Feifei: "That mark... is it Master's?"
菲菲小心拿起一個便當，先聞了聞，才一口一口吃。飯糰怪們圍在旁邊看，有一隻小聲問：: Feifei carefully picks up a bento, sniffs it first, and only then eats it bite by bite. The Onigiri Monsters gather around to watch, and one asks in a small voice: "...Is it good?" Feifei nods, her eyes a little wet. Feifei: "It's just like the ones Master used to make -- the pickled fish always goes right in the middle."
菲菲挑了一個便當，用手帕包好收進行囊。飯糰怪們一起鞠躬，菲菲也趕緊跟著鞠躬。菲菲: Feifei picks out a bento, wraps it in her handkerchief, and stows it in her pack. The Onigiri Monsters all bow together, and Feifei hurriedly bows along with them. Feifei: "Th-thank you... I'll save it for when I need it most."
菲菲洗了手，跟飯糰怪們一起包便當。她把每顆飯糰捏得一樣大，排得整整齊齊。收工時，: Feifei washes her hands and packs bentos together with the Onigiri Monsters. She shapes every rice ball to the same size and lines them up neatly. When the shift ends, the foreman counts out forty-five Dried Fish for her. Feifei: "Um... who are these bentos being delivered to?" The foreman points at the ceiling: "For the gatekeepers upstairs. The one for the very top comes back every day, completely untouched." Feifei: "...Master used to skip meals just like this whenever he got busy."
塔中的廚房熱得像蒸籠。一群繫著小圍裙的飯糰怪排成一排，正把飯糰和醃魚塞進一個個便: The kitchen in the middle of the tower is as hot as a steamer. A row of Onigiri Monsters in little aprons stands in a line, stuffing rice balls and pickled fish into bento boxes, each lid labeled "Send Upstairs". The moment they see Feifei, they all freeze in fright. Feifei freezes too. Feifei: "I-I didn't come to fight..."
菲菲閉著眼睛數了三次拍子，才衝進木人巷。她閃過大半，還是被掃中好幾下，手臂上多了: Feifei counts the beat three times with her eyes closed before dashing into the Wooden Dummy Alley. She dodges most of them but still takes several hits, leaving a few bruises on her arms. When she reaches the last dummy, its arm stops an inch from the tip of her nose, and a little flag painted with a cat paw pops up from the top of its head with a "pop". Feifei: "...I-I passed? I really passed?"
菲菲趴下來，從木人腳邊鑽進機關底下。齒輪咬合的地方掉了一地零件，還有幾枚前人留下: Feifei drops to the floor and wriggles beneath the mechanism from beside the dummies' feet. Parts litter the ground where the gears mesh, along with a few darts left by those who came before. As she gathers them, she hugs her tail to her chest so the gears can't catch it. Feifei: "These needle-shaped ones... might be usable."
菲菲掀開木板，雙手扳下總開關。整條走廊的木人一起停了下來——只有最裡面那一個，自: Feifei lifts the wooden panel and pulls down the master switch with both hands. Every wooden dummy in the corridor stops at once -- all except the one at the very back, which turns around by itself and walks toward her. Feifei: "Y-you're not hooked up to the switch, are you?"
一條長長的木造走廊，兩邊站滿了木人，每一個的手臂都接著齒輪。地上刻著一排腳印，旁: A long wooden corridor, lined on both sides with wooden dummies, each with its arms linked to gears. A row of footprints is carved into the floor, with writing beside it: "Only those who can get through have truly learned." The instant Feifei takes one step forward, the nearest dummy swings its arm with a "clack", brushing past her bangs. Startled, she retreats to where she started. On the wall is a panel that looks like it can be lifted, and behind it comes the sound of turning gears.
菲菲用手帕包著，把星星撿起來。燙得她眼淚都冒出來，還是咬著牙沒鬆手，一路捧到袋子: Wrapping it in her handkerchief, Feifei picks up the star. It burns so much that tears spring to her eyes, but she grits her teeth and doesn't let go, carrying it in cupped hands all the way into her bag. Inside the bag, the star slowly cools and turns into a Relic that feels pleasantly warm to the touch. Feifei: "It's so hot... but so beautiful."
菲菲把水倒在星星上，「嘶」地冒出一大團白煙。她用針尖小心刮下一點星屑，抹在針上；: Feifei pours water over the star, and it lets out a huge cloud of white smoke with a "hiss". She carefully scrapes off some stardust with the tip of a needle and smears it on the needle; the moment the needle leaves her hand, it trails a thin line of light. The rest she wraps into a small packet and puts away. Feifei: "Mixed into the medicine... I wonder what would happen. I'll note it down first."
菲菲抱起星星，用力往天上一拋，拋得不太高，她又踮起腳推了一下。星星搖搖晃晃地飛回: Feifei picks up the star and flings it hard into the sky; it doesn't go very high, so she stands on tiptoe and gives it another push. The star wobbles back to the constellation with the missing corner, fits itself back in, and twinkles twice at her. A wash of warm light pours down. Feifei: "...The road home must have stars lighting it too."
塔頂的石台上躺著一顆會發光的石頭，還「滋滋」冒著熱氣，旁邊的石板燒出一個小坑。一: On the stone platform at the top of the tower lies a glowing stone, steaming with a "sizzle", and the slab beside it is scorched into a small pit. An old bronze astrolabe lies toppled to one side, its pointer aimed at a constellation in the sky that is missing one corner. Feifei crouches down, not daring to get too close. Feifei: "Is it... trembling?"
菲菲閉上眼睛，抱著竹筒靜靜地聽。聽到第三輪，她發現有一段鈴聲總是慢半拍——就像她: Feifei closes her eyes and listens quietly, hugging her bamboo tube. By the third round, she notices one stretch of chimes is always half a beat late -- just like the hesitation she feels before every needle throw. She opens her eyes and decides to let that move go. Sitting to hear out the last gust of wind, she feels her shoulders grow less tight. Feifei: "So... this is what my hesitation sounds like."
菲菲跟著鈴聲在長廊裡走步，風好幾次把她吹得站不穩，她就抓著欄杆再站起來。走到最後: Feifei walks step by step along the gallery following the chimes; several times the wind blows her off balance, and she grabs the railing and stands up again. By the final round, her footsteps land exactly on the chimes. Feifei: "No matter how strong the wind, if I follow it... I won't fall."
菲菲用一根絲線把鈴舌綁回啞掉的風鈴，取了下來。那一瞬間，整條長廊的風鈴都安靜了。: Feifei ties the clapper back onto the silent wind chime with a length of silk thread and takes it down. In that instant, every wind chime along the whole gallery goes quiet. She takes one step forward, and the wind chime in her hand gives a "ting". Feifei: "...From now on, wherever I go, it will tell me I'm still moving forward."
塔頂的長廊掛滿了風鈴，幾百個，大大小小。夜風一吹，全部一起響，吵得菲菲捂住耳朵。: The gallery at the top of the tower is hung with wind chimes, hundreds of them, large and small. When the night wind blows, they all ring together, so loud that Feifei covers her ears. But after listening a while, she realizes it isn't random ringing -- the chimes come in waves, as if someone were performing moves. At the far end of the gallery, one wind chime is mute, its clapper fallen on the floor. Feifei: "That one... is it lonely?"
菲菲用手帕隔著，把結晶撿起來收進懷裡。胸口立刻一沉，好像有什麼在輕輕拉著她往上走: Using her handkerchief as a barrier, Feifei picks up the crystal and tucks it close to her chest. Her chest immediately grows heavy, as if something were gently pulling her upward. She looks down at the standing water, and a flash of purple light crosses the eyes of her reflection, then goes out. Feifei presses a hand tightly to her chest. Feifei: "Master... have you been pulled along like this the whole time?"
菲菲閉上眼睛，把竹筒重重敲在結晶上。結晶碎成一地紫砂，一股冷風衝上來，把她推倒在: Feifei closes her eyes and brings her bamboo tube down hard on the crystal. It shatters into purple sand all over the floor, and a blast of cold wind surges up and knocks her to the ground. When the wind dies down, she finds she can't even remember how to perform the two moves she gets wrong most often -- just as well. Feifei: "It, it shattered... if only the one inside Master could shatter like this too."
菲菲撕下一截袖布，把結晶包了三層，走到欄杆邊丟下去。紫光越來越小，看不見了。塔頂: Feifei tears off a length of sleeve cloth, wraps the crystal in three layers, walks to the railing, and throws it over the edge. The purple light gets smaller and smaller until it disappears. Another low growl comes from the top of the tower, and this time nothing lights up in response. Feifei: "One piece fewer... Master should hurt a little less, right?"
石台的裂縫裡卡著一塊紫色的結晶，一明一暗，像在呼吸，四周的石頭都蒙上一層紫霜。菲: A purple crystal is wedged in a crack in the stone platform, flickering bright and dim as if breathing, and the surrounding stone is coated with a layer of purple frost. Just as Feifei leans in close, a low growl from Master echoes from the top of the tower -- and the crystal flares in response. Startled, she steps back, then slowly walks up again. Feifei: "This color... is the same as Master's eyes that night."
菲菲閉著眼睛，一塊一塊踩過去，繩子一直被拉得很緊，一次也沒晃。她抱著秘寶回來，才: Feifei closes her eyes and steps across plank by plank, the rope held taut the whole time, never wobbling once. She comes back hugging the Relic and only then sees that {同伴}'s hands are rubbed raw and red by the rope. Feifei: "I'm sorry... for making you pull for so long. Give me your hands, I'll bandage them."
菲菲把繩子纏在手上，腳抵住木樁。{同伴}每往前一步，繩子就扯一下，她的手心很快就: Feifei wraps the rope around her hands and braces her feet against the wooden post. With every step {同伴} takes forward, the rope gives a tug, and her palms are soon rubbed raw, but she never lets go, not once. Only when {同伴} comes back hugging the Relic does she slump to the ground. Feifei: "I-I didn't let go, you know... not even once."
菲菲和{同伴}一起拆下兩塊木板，扛去賣給樓梯口的舊貨攤，各換了三十條小魚乾。菲菲: Feifei and {同伴} pull two planks off together, carry them to the secondhand stall by the stairs, and each get thirty Dried Fish in exchange. Feifei quietly lets out a breath of relief. Feifei: "Good thing... nobody has to fall down."
地牢中間裂開一道深溝，上面掛著一條爛木板吊橋。對岸石台上擺著一只刻著魔物紋的寶箱: A deep chasm splits the middle of the dungeon, spanned by a suspension bridge of rotting planks. On the stone platform on the far side sits a chest engraved with a monster crest. A rope is tied to the post at the near end of the bridge, with words carved beside it: "One at a time. Pull it taut, then go." Feifei steps on the first plank, which sags with a "creak", and she hurriedly pulls her foot back. Feifei: "It, it can only hold one person... {稱}, what do we do?"
{同伴}在下面一坐，菲菲就被抬了上去。她死命抱著木架，好一會兒才敢睜眼，把布包和: {同伴} sits down below, and Feifei is lifted up. She clings to the wooden shelf for dear life and takes a good while to dare open her eyes, then scoops the cloth bundle and the little wooden box into her arms. Feifei: "I-I got them... {稱}, whatever you do, don't suddenly stand up!"
菲菲坐上低的那頭，緊緊抓著把手，把{同伴}送了上去。她一動也不敢動，只好盯著翹翹: Feifei sits on the low end, gripping the handle tightly, and sends {同伴} up. Not daring to move a muscle, she can only stare at the seesaw's pivot turning slowly; after watching it for a while, she suddenly grasps the angle of a needle-retracting move, and finds a small pouch of Dried Fish underneath. Feifei: "I-I can hold it down... take your time getting it."
菲菲本來只想坐一下，{同伴}一使力，她就被彈得老高，忍不住叫出聲，然後笑了。玩到: Feifei only meant to sit for a moment, but the instant {同伴} pushes down hard, she is bounced way up high, can't help crying out, and then laughs. By the end of playing, both of them are sitting on the ground panting. Feifei: "It's been so long... so long since I laughed like this."
機關房中間有一座巨大的木頭翹翹板，一頭高高翹起，直頂到天花板旁的木架——架上擺著: In the middle of the mechanism room stands a huge wooden seesaw, one end tilted high, reaching all the way up to a wooden shelf near the ceiling -- on the shelf sit a cloth bundle and a small wooden box. The other end rests flat against the ground, with a cat paw print carved beside it. Feifei looks up at the towering shelf and gulps. Feifei: "If I go up there... what if I can't get down? {稱}, wh-what do you think?"
